name: Wmns Air Jordan 1 Low 'White Wolf Grey'
story_html: The Women’s Air Jordan 1 Low ‘White Wolf Grey’ brings neutral two-tone color blocking to a timeless silhouette modeled after the 1985 original. The all-leather upper combines a white foundation with light grey overlays and a color-matched Swoosh. A silver Jumpman is embroidered on the tongue, while a retro Wings logo is imprinted on the back heel. The sneaker rides on a white rubber midsole, enhanced with encapsulated Air-sole cushioning and supported by a translucent rubber outsole.
